cohort: 1841 late preterm and term neonates (gestational age ≥34 weeks), with 20 neonates diagnosed with NEC (10 stage IB and 10 stage ≥ II)
finding: Late preterm and term neonates requiring intermediate care, with IUGR and transient tachypnea, were susceptible to NEC, while breast milk feeding was a protective factor.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight of NEC cases: 2529.3 g (SD 493.04 g)
